name: EquityMedQA
description: EquityMedQA is a collection of seven datasets enriched for adversarial queries designed to surface biases and equity-related harms in large language models' long-form medical answers. It includes a multifactorial human assessment framework to evaluate biases and promote health equity in LLM-generated medical information.
reputation: A niche but timely benchmark focused on bias and equity in medical LLM outputs, with growing interest from health AI safety researchers rather than broad community adoption.
notes: Focuses on surfacing biases and equity-related harms in LLMs for medical question answering using diverse human assessments.
